_meta.title: Nazi 'euthanasia' killing sites (Aktion T4 and child 'euthanasia')
_meta.measures: Sites where the Nazi regime murdered people with disabilities: items of class 'euthanasia centre in Nazi Germany' (Q104901283), 'Pediatric Department' (Kinderfachabteilung, Q1741786), and non-person items Wikidata links to Aktion T4 (Q154494) or child euthanasia in Nazi Germany (Q1741723). The six T4 gassing centres named by USHMM (Brandenburg, Grafeneck, Bernburg, Sonnenstein, Hartheim, Hadamar) are all included.
_meta.context_figures: USHMM: T4's own count, 70,273 people killed at the six gassing facilities Jan 1940-Aug 1941; the programme in all phases about 250,000; at least 10,000 children in the child 'euthanasia' programme. https://encyclopedia.ushmm.org/content/en/article/euthanasia-program
_meta.citation: Wikidata contributors; United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, Euthanasia Program.
_meta.notes: Per-centre death tolls are not recorded in Wikidata; only Brandenburg 1940 is given by USHMM on this page. Wikidata coverage of the ~30 children's wards is small (only Am Spiegelgrund is classed).
